Halle is located in North Rhine-Westphalia. **Halle** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ), officially Halle (Westf.) or Halle Westfalen (i.e. Westphalia) to distinguish it from the larger Halle (Saale) "Halle (Saale)"), is a town in the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, 15 km west of Bielefeld. The northern part of the town area of Halle is situated in the Teutoburg Forest mountain range, with the town limits running on the ridge in large parts. Halle borders the town of Borgholzhausen in the northwest, the town of Werther in the northeast, the community of Steinhagen in the southeast and south, the town of Harsewinkel in the southwest and the town of Versmold in the west, all belonging to the district of Gütersloh "Gütersloh (district)").
